name: openCriticalVulnerabilitiesCount
definition: The number of currently open vulnerabilities classified Critical across the in-scope assets; 0 only from a complete read in which every in-scope asset reports none.
population: every non-deprecated asset the scanner lists for one company (the passport's); a read whose rows span more than one company_id, or a row with none, is not measured; the value is the sum over that population
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read (every page, no truncation flag, row total reached) of every active asset of one company, each reporting an integer count; zero only when every active asset reports zero.
citations: ConnectSecure public Swagger, GET /r/asset/asset_view: <pod>/apidocs/swagger.yaml (each vendor pod publishes it), see https://cybercns.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CVB/pages/2128314664/V4+API+Information (read 2026-10-12)

safeguards/compliancemanagement/vanta/opencriticalvulnerabilitiescount.py (third-party proof from the GRC platform, level 3; counts severity CRITICAL, 0 only with the scanner test OK). Field names doc-verified at https://developer.vanta.com/reference/listvulnerabilities, not live-verified

changeLog.change: Registered so the ConnectSecure transforms can emit it. The meaning is the catalogue description made precise; unverified fields are named in the transform docstring.
A Vanta proof-source transform now emits this key from the GRC platform's own vulnerability list; allowedCategories gains Compliance Management for it.

notes: Registered for the ConnectSecure transforms. Other vendors' transforms already emit this key (Intruder, Rapid7, Action1, Amazon Inspector); whether they measure the same population was not reviewed, so the key stays proposed and V0 and the owner is not yet named.
